prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Future Desktop Companion", "Explore each pet's personality and habits to find your perfect fit."]
1: ["Meet Your Pet on Your Desktop!", "Try right-clicking your pet to hide, summon, or adjust settings at any time.", "Right-click your pet on screen to open quick controls.", "Got It, Let's Go!"]
2: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your new pet a name and sign the pledge to welcome them home.", "Enter pet name", "Certified Desktop Companion"]
3: ["Welcome to Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "Choose how you want to bring your desktop pet to life today.", "Interactive pets that live right on your desktop."]
4: ["Creating & Spawning Your Pet", "Preparing assets, setting desktop display layer, and waking up your companion.", "Generating pet model...", "Display position check"]
5: ["Returning user? Sign in with your original account method to keep your saved pets."]
6: ["Ensure photos feature clear lighting and full face visibility to prevent generation errors."]
7: ["Quick Desktop Controls", "Everything you need to know to interact with your pet on your desktop.", "Right-click pet for main menu & settings", "Click and drag pet to place anywhere on desktop", "Use tray icon to quickly hide or summon pet"]
8: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet", "Select your existing provider to seamlessly sync your desktop pet profile.", "Continue with Google", "Continue with Apple", "Sign in with Email"]
9: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet...", "We'll notify you as soon as your pet is ready to appear on your desktop."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal photos with clear face visibility
